description: This source file defines core plugin functions for the lighttpd web server, including WSGI application setup, HTML caching, user authentication, and x-sendfile support.

methods.name: wsgi
methods.description: Sets up a WSGI application route with a specified URL prefix and backend actions.

methods.name: cached_html
methods.description: Returns a cached HTML handler that serves .html files or performs a cache action.

methods.name: auth_require_user
methods.description: Requires authentication for specified users, returning an access deny if the user is not authorized.

methods.name: xsendfile
methods.description: Configures support for x-sendfile with a specified document root.
